sources.quote: This page only shows the original pricing for model API calls, excluding any limited-time promotions.
sources.supports: Alibaba distinguishes its original model API prices from temporary promotional offers.
The official Singapore (International) rate for prompts up to 256k: input $0.25, output $1.5 per million tokens.
The official Singapore (International) rate for prompts above 256k and up to 1m: input $1, output $4 per million tokens.
The archived provider pricing page records the same standard and long-context tiers in September 2026.

notes: The available official model page labels its figures original pricing excluding limited-time promotions; the models.dev figures are 25% below these rates, consistent with promotional rather than standard prices. The source set does not show these official rates at or near the May 22 start: the May 1 and June 1 pricing-page snapshots omit qwen3.6-flash, so the start-period timing cannot be independently established.
